functions.name: create-response
functions.description: Create one feedback response with text, score, data type, data source and optional customer metadata.

projectKey.description: Project routing key receiving the response.

comment.description: Ordinary feedback text; empty text is sent as empty, omission does not supply text.

score.description: Feedback score in the selected data type's scale; no universal range is assumed.

segments.description: Optional segment properties keyed by provider property keys; empty object is sent as empty.

type.description: Provider property type label; obtain the appropriate label from project configuration or existing responses.

value.description: Property value sent as ordinary text; empty string is an explicit empty value, not deletion.

additionalProperties.description: A property retaining its provider display label, type label and text value.

userMetadata.description: Optional user metadata keyed by property keys, such as customer_id; may contain personal information.

type.description: Provider property type label; obtain the appropriate label from project configuration or existing responses.

value.description: Property value sent as ordinary text; empty string is an explicit empty value, not deletion.

additionalProperties.description: A property retaining its provider display label, type label and text value.

comment.description: Ordinary feedback text; empty text is sent as empty, omission does not supply text.

score.description: Feedback score in the selected data type's scale; no universal range is assumed.

FunctionInput_chattermill_createresponse.description: One feedback response, requiring a comment or score, with optional typed customer and segment properties.

id.description: Opaque ID of the newly created response.

projectKey.description: Project routing key receiving the response.

FunctionOutput_chattermill_createrespons.description: The established identity of the newly created feedback response.

tags.instructions: Get projectKey from `list-projects`, dataTypeKey from `list-data-types` and dataSourceKey from `list-data-sources`. Provide comment or score. Property maps retain provider type labels, display names and values. Creation is not proven replay-safe: if the result is uncertain, inspect responses before retrying. Use `update-response` only for an existing response's metadata.

functions.name: delete-response-permanently
functions.description: Permanently erase one response by ID for a data-erasure request. The operation cannot be reversed.

responseId.description: Opaque ID of the single response to erase permanently.

FunctionInput_chattermill_deleteresponse.description: Identify the single response to erase permanently and its owning project.

id.description: Opaque response ID whose deletion the provider acknowledged.

deleted.description: True only after the provider acknowledges successful deletion; not a claim of customer-wide erasure.

FunctionOutput_chattermill_deleterespons.description: Provider acknowledgment of permanent deletion of one response, not customer-wide erasure.

tags.instructions: Use `search-responses` to locate the correct response for an erasure request and `get-response` if needed to inspect it. Supply its projectKey and responseId. This irreversibly deletes that response, not every response belonging to the customer. Continue searching pages to identify other records; do not treat one deletion as complete customer erasure. If the result is uncertain, inspect the target before retrying.

functions.name: get-metric
functions.description: Get NPS, average score, net sentiment or response volume for a project, optionally filtered by time, category, theme and sentiment.

to.description: Optional upper time bound with explicit offset and whole-second precision.

from.description: Optional lower time bound with explicit offset and whole-second precision; inclusivity follows provider behavior.

metric.description: Metric to calculate: provider NPS, average score, net sentiment or volume; values retain provider scale.

sentiment.description: Optional provider sentiment code -1, 0 or 1, passed without reinterpretation.

themeName.description: Optional exact theme name, not theme ID.

categoryName.description: Optional exact category name, not category ID.

FunctionInput_chattermill_getmetric.description: Project, metric and optional time and exact-name filters for one aggregate.

value.description: Provider's numeric aggregate in its original metric scale; null only when the provider explicitly returns an undefined or null aggregate, not fabricated zero.

metric.description: Requested metric, echoed for result interpretation.

projectKey.description: Project routing key for the aggregate.

FunctionOutput_chattermill_getmetric.description: One provider aggregate and the project and metric that identify it.

tags.instructions: Get projectKey from `list-projects`. Choose a metric; use names from `list-categories` and `list-themes` for those filters, not their IDs. Supply whole-second timestamps with explicit offsets. This returns one aggregate value, not individual feedback; use `list-responses` or `search-responses` for records.

functions.description: Find one page of responses matching a response ID, user metadata, or a custom segment, including for data-erasure workflows.

FunctionInput_chattermill_searchresponse.description: Search one project using at least one response ID, metadata pair or saved segment criterion.

id.description: Opaque response ID within projectKey.

tagIds.description: Assigned opaque tag IDs if supplied.

themes.description: Available theme assignments; omission does not establish processing state.

sentiment.description: Original -1, 0 or 1 sentiment code if supplied.

items.description: An available theme assignment and its original sentiment.

comment.description: Feedback text; absent, null and empty remain distinct.

segments.description: Segment properties keyed by provider property key.

tags.instructions: Get projectKey from `list-projects`. Supply at least one criterion; metadata matching uses a property key and value together. Use `list-custom-segments` to discover saved segment IDs. Use `list-responses` for date, score, theme and source filtering. Returns one page, default 20, maximum 100. Continue with nextCursor as cursor and unchanged criteria/limit. Inspect matches before using `delete-response-permanently`.

functions.description: Partially update an existing response's segment properties and user metadata. This tool does not edit comment, score, data source or data type.

tags.instructions: Obtain projectKey and responseId from `list-responses` or `search-responses`; inspect current metadata with `get-response`. Supply only property keys to change. Omitted properties remain unchanged; empty string sets an empty value and does not delete a property. Nulls and empty maps are not accepted. This overwrites supplied property values and may race with other writers. Use `create-response` for new feedback.
